functions.name: textured_uniform_sprite_draw
functions.source_contract: Cached void __cdecl(Sprite*, ImageSlot*) prototype, cached checked C++ and complete owning static call closure
functions.arguments: Source sprite pointer and optional source image override on the cdecl stack
functions.admitted: Masked nearest PC24; empty x87 stack; initialized default target or already-created texture target; ordinary uniform-colour textured quad; all cached capability-dependent mode-2 sampler choices; positive bounded tiled resource; crop inside image; no secondary mask, texture override or programmable effect; admitted native trigonometry
callee_volatile: empty x87 register payloads, status and instruction metadata
functions.grid_optimization: For bounded integral UV endpoints, skip clamped-zero prefix spans and unreferenced suffix cells; retain the cumulative PC24 arithmetic through every emitted tile boundary. Fractional UVs keep the full grid calculation. Texture-handle reads and tile order are unchanged.
functions.decline: Leave CPU and game RAM unchanged and execute the same checked static function; no decoder or interpreter

functions.name: uniform_font_glyph_draw
functions.source_contract: Cached void cdecl glyph function, 256-byte Sprite by value and nine DWORD arguments; complete cached static owning function and call closure
functions.arguments: By-value sprite, source character, integer rectangle, margin, cell size, ARGB and font index
functions.admitted: Same native sprite admission; nearest PC24; empty x87 stack; bounded actual source font range table; ordinary font texture crop
callee_volatile: empty x87 payloads, status and instruction metadata
functions.decline: Leave CPU and game RAM unchanged; execute existing checked static function without a decoder or interpreter
